title: Form handling (Ryan Wehe, Christopher Laguna, Rian Franey, Mozilla Winter of Security)
description: A team project that let users define the values the spider puts into forms: core changes in March 2017, an add-on the same month, and its later rename to Value Generator.
narrative:
A tester probably wants control over the values a spider puts into forms. Three Arizona State University students, according to the wiki page, took that on as a senior capstone project. Their aim, the page says, was to let users "define default values based on pattern matching" for spider-filled forms. The Student Hall of Fame lists Ryan Wehe, Christopher Laguna and Rian Franey for the project, from the 2016 Winter term of Mozilla Winter of Security.

In zaproxy, a core commit by Ryan Wehe from March 2017 created ValueGenerator and DefaultValueGenerator. Later that month a zap-extensions commit added a Form Handler extension, whose subject said it would let users custom define the values the Value Generator used for the Spider.

An October 2018 commit integrated its params tab, and in April 2019 it was relocated out of the monolithic tree into its own project. It was promoted to beta in October 2020. From 2022 commits exposed the value generator, removed the core spider, allowed regex matching and added datafaker generated defaults. In May 2023 it was renamed Value Generator, which the 6.3.0 changelog said was to more clearly identify what the add-on does. In 2024 the core ValueGenerator was deprecated, and a November commit moved it out of core and renamed it.

Where things stand: the add-on still exists in zap-extensions under addOns/formhandler, with the name Value Generator and beta status. Its changelog entry for 6.9.0, dated October 2026, says it now depends on the params add-on.

chapters.title: The project
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Ryan Wehe, Christopher Laguna, and Rian Franey for "Form handling (team project)", MWoS, 2016 Winter, with a link to the Mozilla wiki. The wiki page says the three were Arizona State University students working on a senior capstone project, that it aimed to let users "define default values based on pattern matching" for spider-filled forms, and that the first pull request was merged into ZAP 2.6 while a second, an add-on in zap-extensions, was in progress when the page was last edited on March 9, 2017.

evidence.label: Mozilla Winter of Security 2016: ZAP Form Handling

chapters.title: March 2017: core interface, then the add-on
chapters.text: In zaproxy, a commit by Ryan Wehe dated 2017-03-05 is "Create ValueGenerator and DefaultValueGenerator". In zap-extensions, a commit by Ryan Wehe dated 2017-03-22 is "Form Handler Extension This extension will allow the user to custom define values used by the Value Generator for the Spider." Its file list includes ExtensionFormHandler.java, FormHandlerParam.java, FormHandlerValueGenerator.java, an options panel and add/modify field dialogs, and a help page FormHandlerHelp.html.

evidence.label: Mozilla Winter of Security 2016: ZAP Form Handling

chapters.title: 2018 to 2020: params tab, its own project, beta
chapters.text: "Formhandler Params Tab Integration (#1855)" is dated 2018-10-26. On 2019-04-03 the commit "formhandler: relocate to its own project" moves it out of the monolithic tree. "Form handler: promote to beta" is dated 2020-10-27.

chapters.title: 2022 to 2024: exposing the generator and leaving core
chapters.text: Commits in zap-extensions include "formhandler: expose value generator" (2022-08-17), "formhandler: remove core spider usage" (2022-10-14), "formhandler: Allow fields to be matched via regex" (2023-02-26) and "formhandler: Add more default (datafaker generated) values" (2023-03-17). "formhandler: Renamed " Value Generator "" is dated 2023-05-26, and the changelog for 6.3.0 (2023-06-02) says it was renamed to "Value Generator" to more clearly identify what the add-on does. In zaproxy, "Deprecate `ValueGenerator`" is dated 2024-07-30. In zap-extensions, "Move `ValueGenerator` from core and rename it" (2024-11-13) adds DefaultValueProvider.java and ValueProvider.java under addOns/commonlib.

chapters.title: Where it stands
chapters.text: The add-on still exists at HEAD under addOns/formhandler; the dataset names it "Value Generator" with status beta. Its changelog lists 6.9.0 (2026-10-08) as "Now depends on the params add-on (Issue 9210)."
